A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FlowDec and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. All 24 pages were inspected; appendix pages 19–24 are identical in text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original navigation experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, real-robot trials, ablations, and appendix results using Uni-NaVid and different solver-step counts.

after.justification: v3 retains these original simulation, real-robot and supplementary experimental results.

M1.justification: The conditional flow model, three temporal conditions, training schedule, action-centroid filtering and inference initialization remain unchanged. Appendix Algorithms 1–2 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same R2R-CE and RxR-CE navigation coverage, corruption scenarios, pristine-input evaluations and four indoor/outdoor robot tasks. The appendices add no coverage relative to v1.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain NaVid, SCUNet, Dec-DPM and Dec-CM. The appendix comparisons using Uni-NaVid are also unchanged; no evaluated comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, 1,839/3,669 evaluation episodes, SR/SPL metrics, the 100-trajectory warp-error evaluation and training settings remain unchanged. The added ablation-label explanation restates v1’s existing inference-without-filtering setting.

E4.justification: The training-condition, initialization, filtering-threshold and solver-step ablations, temporal-consistency checks and Gaussian Q-Q analysis are retained. Figure 6 adds a full-model curve from existing Table 2 results alongside the existing ablations, rather than introducing a new test.

E5.justification: Both versions report 20 real-world trials per setting and retain the same Q-Q sampling and correlation reporting. No seed information, uncertainty estimates or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their numerical entries and findings. For example, Table 2 reports FlowDec’s average SR as 27.04% and 33.63% in both versions. Figure 6’s added full-model curve redisplays existing results; the retained ablation curves and qualitative examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–14, the flow-matching formulation, Gaussian assumptions, action-centroid definition and latent-filtering mathematics are unchanged. No proof, derivation or formal assumption is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and claims about corruption robustness, temporal consistency, backbone compatibility and inference speed. The new code-release statement concerns access information.

C2.justification: Explanations involving domain mismatch, temporal consistency, accumulated generation errors and speed–accuracy tradeoffs remain unchanged, including the appendix discussion. The future direction concerning dynamically varying noise is also retained.

D1.justification: v3 adds an abstract statement announcing released code and an embedded project-repository hyperlink, absent from v1. Implementation details, hardware and appendix training information remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the access pointer; repository contents were not inspected.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 removes NavGPT-2 [52] from the chain-of-thought-prompting examples while retaining its citation for discrete VLN planning and its bibliography entry. This is a limited attribution adjustment; the same 54 referenced works and overall research positioning remain.

P1.justification: v3 adds an author email, the Image Restoration keyword, the code-release sentence and an explicit explanation of the 'w c1&c2&c3' ablation label. Bibliographic formatting is simplified. The narrative, section order and nearly all prose are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is enlarged and rearranged from three horizontal panels into a larger radar plot beside stacked sensitivity plots, with an additional full-FlowDec curve. Figure 1 is enlarged, and Tables 2–3 and Figure 4 change placement. These are localized display changes and accompanying page reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves accessibility and clarity through the new code-access pointer, more readable Figure 6 and explicit identification of the unfiltered ablation. The method, experimental evidence and appendices remain unchanged, so the gains concern presentation and access information. Actual code usability cannot be established from the supplied PDFs.
